description: This file contains shell script functions for configuring, setting up, and tearing down a network interface using a modem via GCOM commands. It defines functions for initializing configuration, setting up the interface with modem info, and cleaning up during teardown, including error handling and dynamic network configuration.

methods.name: proto_ncm_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the network configuration parameters for the modem, setting default values and adding configuration options.

methods.name: proto_ncm_setup
methods.description: Sets up the network interface by configuring the modem, retrieving manufacturer info, initializing, configuring, and connecting the modem, and setting up DHCP and DHCPv6 networks.

methods.name: proto_ncm_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the network interface by disconnecting the modem and cleaning up resources.
